summary.intent: Execute Phase 22 (performance baselines completion), clean up the code, get it reviewed and merged, then plan the next phases (24-26) of the v1.1 milestone.
summary.outcome: Phase 22 was executed (SDK perf instrumentation, E2E journey timing, load test thresholds), PR #355 was created and merged with all review comments resolved, staging DB was reset to fix a vault init bug, journey timing baselines were populated from staging, phases 24-26 were added to the roadmap, and a worktree was created for parallel work.

repo: Phase 22 research/planning commits were accidentally made directly to main instead of a feature branch — had to move them via branch creation + hard reset

Staging DB schema was out of sync: Phase 20 vault migration removed encrypted_root_folder_key/encrypted_root_ipns_private_key columns and assumed staging DB would be reset, but it wasn't — causing 500 errors on first wallet login
Web3Auth Core Kit MPC init dominates login-to-vault timing at ~23.5s; actual vault load after auth is only 86ms
BYO-IPFS pinning path in upload/index.ts was uninstrumented — only CipherBox path had withPerf wrapping; fixed by adding ipfs:upload:byo marker
ipfs:upload was renamed to ipfs:upload:cipherbox for clarity alongside the new ipfs:upload:byo marker
Bin IPNS 404 bug root cause: no repair flow if DB cache is missing; unclear if initializeBin ever published the initial IPNS record
Device registry format error root cause: schema validator is strict with no versioning or backward-compat layer; registries written by older code fail current validation
Load test 401 failures at 75-100 concurrent clients: PoolClient passes static JWT, no 401 interceptor or token refresh logic exists
Recovery tool (recovery.html) has two modes but v1 export file recovery is dead code since all vaults are now v2 and staging DB was wiped — should be removed
Phase 23 was marked complete in ROADMAP.md ([x]) but STATE.md still showed EXECUTING — a contradiction that was flagged by Copilot review
REQUIREMENTS.md still referenced k6 after the load test harness was switched to Vitest — stale documentation not caught until PR review

code.finding: Concurrent withPerf calls with the same operation name would produce colliding mark names — fixed by adding per-invocation counter to mark names
PERF_ENABLED check using process.env can evaluate to true in browser prod due to bundler polyfills — fixed with typeof process.env?.NODE_ENV === 'string' guard
404 check was missing error.response.status — AxiosError puts status on error.response.status not error.status
pinFn BYO override path was not instrumented with withPerf; added ipfs:upload:byo marker alongside existing ipfs:upload:cipherbox for addToIpfs path
expectThresholdsPassed() helper was extracted to replace 5 identical 8-line boilerplate blocks across all load test scenarios
as any cast on globalThis replaced with declare global { var performance: Performance } for proper typing
Login flow duplication in journey tests is intentional for sub-phase timing capture, not a refactor target

workflow: GSD phase execution was run out of order (22 before 21) — the phase complete tool correctly returned next_phase: 23 but 23 was already done, causing misleading Next Up suggestions
Playwright journey timing tests require running via the test runner (not MCP browser) because installMockWallet uses page.addInitScript which only works in test runner context
Staging DB reset is the correct fix when incremental migrations were deleted under the assumption the DB would be reset — production DBs need explicit migration files
Multiple rounds of PR review comment resolution were needed (4 rounds, 16 total threads); automated reviewers (CodeRabbit, Copilot) generated new threads on each push
Git worktree should be created after phase docs exist on main, not before — branch from latest main with new phases already merged
Merge conflicts between Phase 21 (BYO-IPFS, added pinFn param) and Phase 22 (withPerf wrapping) in upload/index.ts required preserving both changes
GitHub Actions approval requirement appeared unexpectedly on PR #355 — likely triggered by commit author email mismatch or GitHub platform policy change, not a workflow file change
Background task notifications from executor subagents can arrive late (after phase is already complete) and can be safely ignored

friction: Phase 22 commits were made directly to main instead of a feature branch, requiring a manual branch creation + hard reset dance
Staging DB schema mismatch caused 500 errors during journey timing tests — wasted time diagnosing before discovering the root cause in API logs
Playwright temp config file approach failed because testDir was relative to /tmp — required absolute path workaround
4 rounds of PR review comment resolution needed due to automated reviewers generating new threads on each push
GitHub Actions lint-pr-title required manual approval unexpectedly — root cause unclear, may be GitHub platform policy change
Context limit interruption mid-session (usage reset required) caused a gap in the PR review flow
GSD phase tool incorrectly suggested phase 23 as next even though it was already marked [x] in ROADMAP.md
open_items: Phase 24: Fix bin IPNS 404 bug — add auto-repair flow when DB cache is missing; investigate whether initializeBin published the initial record
Phase 24: Fix device registry format error — add schema versioning (v1/v2) with backward-compat validation and migration path
Phase 24: Headless sdk-core load tests — direct function-level load tests calling sdk-core without CipherBoxClient wrapper
Phase 24: Recovery tool cleanup — remove dead v1 export file recovery mode, keep only IPFS-direct v2 blob recovery; add Playwright E2E tests
Phase 24: Load test 401 token refresh — add 401 interceptor with re-auth and folder metadata reload to PoolClient
Phase 25: Desktop TEE file enrollment for new files
Phase 26: Grafana alerting thresholds based on Phase 18/22 baselines
Phase 26: Timeout tuning for sub-2s UX using baseline data
PR #355 human verification items: run journey tests against live services to populate baseline measurements; confirm Performance API marks visible in browser DevTools
Writable shares deferred: IPNS single-writer model, optimistic concurrency with sequence numbers, and TEE multi-key enrollment are all blockers
E2E tests re-run needed after timeout on release PR CI run (web-e2e job was cancelled)
13 pending todos and 1 active debug session noted in progress report
